bio: Mt. Everest Real-Estate assists families and buyers in finding genuine residential, commercial, and agricultural land in Nepal. We specialize in verified land plots in Lalitpur (Lubhu, Lamatar), Bara (Kolhabi), and Chitwan (Madi, Meghauli). With our head office located at Samakhushi 26, Kathmandu, clear Lalpurja ownership, accurate cadastral boundaries, and road access, we focus on safe and transparent property transactions.
